name: facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/deprecated/tutorial_recurrent_policy/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.run_A2C_training: run the A2C class to train a recurrent policy agent using parallel environment batchers
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.create_A2C_instance: create an A2C instance with config, environment factories, and agent factory for recurrent policy training
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.compute_get_loss: compute the critic loss, A2C loss, and entropy loss from sampled trajectories using get_loss
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.review_A2C_run_loop: review the A2C run method training loop that alternates between sampling trajectories and gradient updates
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.summarize_A2C_temporal_difference: summarize how A2C computes temporal difference targets using critic values and discounted rewards

facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.create_RecurrentAgent: create a RecurrentAgent instance with a model and number of actions for recurrent policy execution
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.call_RecurrentAgent_step: call the RecurrentAgent to execute one step and return action probabilities and new state
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.update_RecurrentAgent_model: update the RecurrentAgent model weights by loading a new state dictionary
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.build_AgentModel: build an AgentModel neural network that computes action scores from observations and hidden state
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.build_BaselineModel: build a BaselineModel neural network that computes state value V(s) for the critic

facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.create_gym_env: create a gym environment by calling gym.make with the given environment name string
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.create_env: create a batch of GymEnv instances with TimeLimit wrappers for parallel environment execution
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.create_train_env: create a batch of GymEnvInf instances for training with multiple parallel environments
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.create_agent: create a RecurrentAgent instance with a given model and number of action dimensions
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.run_experiment: run an A2C reinforcement learning experiment on CartPole-v0 using the Experiment class
